subject: general
question: Where is Mountain peak “Saddle” located?
solution:
__
 
• Located in the Bay of Bengal, **Andaman and Nicobar Islands**__ is an archipelago consisting of about** **600 islands out of which only around 36 islands are inhabited.
 
• Saddle Peak which is also known as Saddle Peak National Park is the highest point in Andaman Island.
 
• The*__ Ten-degree channel__* separates the Andaman islands group from Nicobar.
 
• The*__ Eight-degree channel__* separates Lakshadweep group from the Maldives
 
• The*__ Nine-degree Channel__* separates Minicoy from the Lakshadweep islands.
